name: apify
label: Apify
description: Access Apify tools for web scraping, data extraction, and automation.

apikey.label: API Key
apikey.description: Find your API key on Apify in the settings, API & Integrations section.

apify_find_actor.label: Find Actor
apify_find_actor.description: Searches the public Apify Store for Actors by name or keyword.

search.label: Search Query
search.description: Name or keyword to search the Apify Store for (e.g. "instagram scraper"). Leave empty to list popular store actors.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return. Default 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of actors to skip at the start. Default 0.

apify_get_actor.label: Get Actor
apify_get_actor.description: Retrieves metadata for a single Apify Actor by ID.

actorId.label: Actor ID
actorId.description: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.

apify_list_actors.label: List Actors
apify_list_actors.description: Lists the Actors owned by the authenticated account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return. Default 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of actors to skip at the start. Default 0.

apify_get_actor_input_schema.label: Get Actor Input Schema
apify_get_actor_input_schema.description: Retrieves the input schema (fields, types, required, enums) of an Actor's default build.

actorId.label: Actor ID
actorId.description: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.

apify_get_actor_run.label: Get Actor Run
apify_get_actor_run.description: Retrieves the status and details of an Actor run by run ID.

runId.label: Run ID
runId.description: The ID of the run to read. Obtain it from Run Actor, List Actor Runs, or Get Last Actor Run.

waitForFinish.label: Wait For Finish (seconds)
waitForFinish.description: Optional. Block server-side up to this many seconds (max 60) waiting for the run to reach a terminal state before returning. Leave empty for an immediate status read.

apify_abort_actor_run.label: Abort Actor Run
apify_abort_actor_run.description: Stops a running Actor run by run ID.

runId.label: Run ID
runId.description: The ID of the run to abort. Obtain it from Run Actor or List Actor Runs.

gracefully.label: Gracefully
gracefully.description: If true, send a graceful abort so the actor can finish its current cycle and persist state before stopping. If false, the run is killed immediately.

apify_list_actor_runs.label: List Actor Runs
apify_list_actor_runs.description: Lists the run history of a single Actor.

actorId.label: Actor ID
actorId.description: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return. Default 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of runs to skip at the start. Default 0.

apify_list_runs.label: List Runs
apify_list_runs.description: Lists Actor runs across the whole account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return. Default 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of runs to skip at the start. Default 0.

apify_get_last_actor_run.label: Get Last Actor Run
apify_get_last_actor_run.description: Retrieves the most recent run of an Actor, optionally filtered by status.

actorId.label: Actor ID
actorId.description: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.

status.label: Status
status.description: Optionally restrict to the last run with this status.

apify_get_build.label: Get Build
apify_get_build.description: Retrieves the status and metadata of an Actor build by build ID.

buildId.label: Build ID
buildId.description: The ID of the build to read. Obtain it from an actor's build list or a run's buildId.

waitForFinish.label: Wait For Finish (seconds)
waitForFinish.description: Optional. Block server-side up to this many seconds (max 60) waiting for the build to finish before returning. Leave empty for an immediate status read.

apify_get_dataset.label: Get Dataset
apify_get_dataset.description: Retrieves metadata for an Apify dataset by dataset ID.

datasetId.label: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: The ID of the dataset. Obtain it from List Datasets or a run's defaultDatasetId (Get Actor Run).

apify_list_datasets.label: List Datasets
apify_list_datasets.description: Lists the datasets in the authenticated account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of datasets to return. Default 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of datasets to skip at the start. Default 0.

apify_list_key_value_stores.label: List Key-Value Stores
apify_list_key_value_stores.description: Lists the key-value stores in the authenticated account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of stores to return. Default 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of stores to skip at the start. Default 0.

apify_get_key_value_store.label: Get Key-Value Store
apify_get_key_value_store.description: Retrieves metadata for an Apify key-value store by store ID.

storeId.label: Key-Value Store ID
storeId.description: The ID of the key-value store. Obtain it from List Key-Value Stores or a run's defaultKeyValueStoreId.

apify_list_key_value_store_keys.label: List Key-Value Store Keys
apify_list_key_value_store_keys.description: Lists the record keys in an Apify key-value store.

storeId.label: Key-Value Store ID
storeId.description: The ID of the key-value store. Obtain it from List Key-Value Stores or a run's defaultKeyValueStoreId.

prefix.label: Key Prefix
prefix.description: Optional. Only return keys starting with this prefix.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of keys to return.

apify_list_tasks.label: List Tasks
apify_list_tasks.description: Lists the saved Actor tasks in the authenticated account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return. Default 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of tasks to skip at the start. Default 0.

apify_get_task.label: Get Task
apify_get_task.description: Retrieves metadata for a saved Actor task by task ID.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The ID of the saved task. Obtain it from List Tasks.

apify_get_task_last_run.label: Get Task Last Run
apify_get_task_last_run.description: Retrieves the most recent run of a saved Actor task, optionally filtered by status.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The ID of the saved task. Obtain it from List Tasks.

status.label: Status
status.description: Optionally restrict to the last run with this status.

apify_update_task_input.label: Update Task Input
apify_update_task_input.description: Overwrites the stored input body of a saved Actor task by task ID.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The ID of the saved task to reconfigure. Obtain it from List Tasks.

input.label: Input JSON
input.description: The full JSON input body to store on the task. This replaces the existing input entirely. Match the Actor's input schema (see Get Actor Input Schema for the task's actor).

apify_create_task.label: Create Task
apify_create_task.description: Creates a new saved Actor task.

name.label: Name
name.description: Unique name for the task (within your account). Creation fails if the name is already taken.

actorId.label: Actor ID
actorId.description: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor this task wraps. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.

input.label: Input JSON
input.description: The JSON input body to store on the task. Match the Actor's input schema (see Get Actor Input Schema).

apify_get_account.label: Get Account
apify_get_account.description: Retrieves the authenticated Apify account profile.

apify_get_account_limits.label: Get Account Limits
apify_get_account_limits.description: Retrieves the authenticated account's plan limits and current usage.

watchActorRunsTrigger.label: Watch Actor Runs
watchActorRunsTrigger.description: Triggers a Flow on Apify Actor run events

actorid.label: Actor
actorid.description: Select an Actor from the list.

statuses.label: Statuses
statuses.description: Run statuses to watch, as a JSON list of: ACTOR.RUN.ABORTED, ACTOR.RUN.FAILED, ACTOR.RUN.SUCCEEDED, ACTOR.RUN.TIMED_OUT.

watchTaskRunsTrigger.label: Watch Task Runs
watchTaskRunsTrigger.description: Triggers a Flow on Apify Actor task run events

taskid.label: Actor Task
taskid.description: Select a task from the list.

statuses.label: Statuses
statuses.description: Run statuses to watch, as a JSON list of: ACTOR.RUN.ABORTED, ACTOR.RUN.FAILED, ACTOR.RUN.SUCCEEDED, ACTOR.RUN.TIMED_OUT.
